findings.claim: The low pasture line was entered in the field book at ten chains and fifty-three links. R1 requires that the surveyor of record, who has not left the dale, get that figure back. The draft has him a chain and forty-seven links away from his own entry, and calls it identical only because it agreed with itself on a second pull. The chapter's whole premise inverts.
findings.fix: Re-measured figure becomes ten chains, fifty-three links, twice.
findings.reference: bible/world.md R1, and the field-book entry established on Day 2

findings.quote: The 1836 plan is 47 links in error over this line.
findings.claim: Forty-seven links is the gap between ten chains fifty-three links and the plan's rather more than eleven chains, with the surveyor's figure the shorter. Against eleven chains sixty-two links the gap is neither forty-seven nor in that direction.
findings.fix: Resolves itself once the re-measured figure is corrected.
findings.reference: bible/world.md R1 and the world bible's account of the four disagreeing plans

findings.claim: A hundred links to the Gunter's chain, so a line of ten chains and a bit is run in about eleven pulls. Sixty-two is a link count mistaken for a count of pulls.

findings.quote: On the Monday he took the chain out alone.
findings.claim: bible/timeline.md puts the beacon poles, the re-measurement and the margin note all on Day 4; the draft splits them across Sunday and Monday.
findings.fix: Move the re-measurement back to Sunday, or reconcile the split.

resolution: All three blocking findings from iteration 1 were addressed by three literal substitutions supplied by the writer and applied by the orchestrator; none was skipped and none of the quoted text survived. Iteration 2's sole finding is marked LATE by the critic itself - equally present in the first draft and not reported then - and is recorded in specs/loops/LOOP-003/late_findings.jsonl.
arbitration_of_the_late_finding: OVERRULED as a defect against the draft. The Chapter 3 outline entry commissions 'Days 4-5, Sunday 14 and Monday 15 May' and its beat 3 begins 'Alone on the Monday'. The writer obeyed its commission exactly, and penalising a chapter for writing what it was told to write is the failure the FLOW-3 outline audit exists to prevent. The divergence is real but it is between the OUTLINE and the timeline, introduced at FLOW-3, and it is harmless: Day 5 carries no other timeline event and nothing downstream turns on which of the two days the re-measurement fell.
blocking_score_note: feedback.late_finding_blocks is false. With the late finding excluded, iteration 2 carries no live finding. The raw score the critic returned was 5 and is recorded above unaltered.
